newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Robotics introduces digital devices.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Robotics introduces digital devices.

text.p: U.S. Robotics Corp said Wednesday it introduced its first two products for Digital Subscriber Line (DSL) remote access at a conference in Germany.

In a statement released here, the computer modem manufacturer said the products provide high-speed access to corporate local area networks and to the Internet over standard telephone lines. The products will be generally available in early May, the company said.
Last month, U.S. Robotics agreed to merge with 3Com Corp last month in a stock deal valued at $7.3 billion.
U.S. Robotics shares closed down 1-1/8 at 58-3/8.
